title: Docs: bind the selected k8 provider to the historical catalogue scope
body:
The frozen 71-record owner catalogue excludes the currently selected k8 inventory/profile. This adds a reproducible source chain from the selected manifest to that applicability boundary, records its exact seven-slot delta from the already-excluded R480 interface, and links the receipt from the bottleneck brief. Exact membership and three alias controls prevent confusing shared rank mass with catalogue membership. It adds navigation evidence, not a new catalogue theorem.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b8f150781b0a7a1edc5d686e8ee9c7ee653ea171/research/selected-k8-catalogue-scope/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
